text:
maria (Finance): Heads up—we've seen 12 invoices for Zephyr Labs generate with missing 'Reserved GPU compute' line and two invoices created for the same billing period.
aj (Billing Eng): Hmm. Did the invoice-job log any retries? Can you paste the invoice IDs?
maria (Finance): Invoice IDs: INV-2024-1187, INV-2024-1187-1 (duplicate). The correct invoice should include `reserved_gpu_hours` = 240 and discount line. Current PDF shows only compute-on-demand lines. Here are the raw lines:
```
line_items:
 - sku: compute_on_demand
   qty: 120
   amount_cents: 480000
 - sku: support_monthly
   qty: 1
   amount_cents: 25000
```
(no reserved_gpu line)
noah (Ops): I see an error in billing-worker logs around 2145678890: `KeyError: 'reserved_gpu_hours'` followed by a retry loop.
billing-bot: Automated alert: invoice-job retry detected for customer_id=zephyr-42 at ts=2145678891, attempts=2
aj (Billing Eng): That KeyError suggests the proration step couldn't find the committed capacity object. Possibly a race: commitment table update vs invoice render.
sara (Revenue Ops): Zephyr reported they received two PDFs and are asking which one is correct. We need to prevent duplicate charging and send a corrected invoice asap.
leo (Support): Tagging the customer thread: "We're investigating—won't be charged twice; will reissue corrected invoice." Asked them to hold payments.
maria (Finance): Can eng roll a hotfix to avoid skipping reserved lines and dedupe retries? Also need a script to reconcile affected customers and credit the duplicates.
aj (Billing Eng): I'll dig in. Quick mitigation: disable automatic retries for invoice render for 30m and enqueue a manual job for affected customers.
noah (Ops): Done: retries paused, manual queue created. I've exported the affected customer list: zephyr-42, arcadia-09, luminous-77 (total 12 accounts).
aj (Billing Eng): Patch incoming: PR changes invoice renderer to treat missing commitment as zero but still include a line item with note `commitment_unavailable` so Finance can see it. Also adds idempotency token check before writing invoice ID.
maria (Finance): Thanks. Once PR is merged, what's ETA for reissuing corrected invoices?
aj (Billing Eng): CI green -> deploy in 20m, then we'll regenerate invoices overnight. I'll share a list when done.
sara (Revenue Ops): Please include credit note flow for duplicates and a one-time apology credit for affected customers.
maria (Finance): Agree. I'll prepare the credit notes template and upload to accounting system.
leo (Support): I'll update the customer-facing message and follow up after reissue. :thumbsup: 
aj (Billing Eng): PR merged and deployed at ts=2145679370. Starting regen for those 12 accounts. Logs: `regen: success 10/12, fail 2/12 (missing commitment id)`.
maria (Finance): Which two failed?
aj (Billing Eng): zephyr-42 succeeded; failures: luminous-77 (commitment record corrupted), arcadia-09 (missing commitment due to earlier migration). I'll attach remediation steps.
noah (Ops): I'll restore luminous-77 from DB backup and fix migration for arcadia-09.
billing-bot: Automated note: invoices reissued for 10 accounts at ts=2145679490. Credit notes queued for duplicates.
sara (Revenue Ops): Great — please loop in Legal if any SLAs breached.
maria (Finance): Filing internal postmortem and billing incident. Thanks everyone.
leo (Support): Closing customer loop now.
